purpose: Keep every chat that works on ooDialog for Linux, or on ooDialog/WASM's oodWeb.cls that it hosts, working from the same facts: what the Qt6 renderer is, the contract it shares with the browser page, how it is tested, where it stands against each oodialog-wasm release, what has gone wrong and why, and how to continue.
title: ooDialog on Linux: the Qt6 renderer behind oodWeb.cls
